capabilities: Runs a local MCP server exposing 15 vault tools
Connects Claude Code, Cursor, Cline and Windsurf to the vault
Chats with any OpenAI-compatible model in a built-in agent panel
Persists chat history and exports conversations to notes
Encrypts stored API keys with AES-256-GCM
extras: MCP server is desktop-only (needs Node's http module); chat, history and export work on mobile. No telemetry; API keys encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM/PBKDF2, while the MCP token stays plaintext by design. Installable via BRAT; docs include Chinese translation, protocol test suite and troubleshooting FAQ.
problem: External AI agents have no standard local way to read and edit Obsidian vault notes without uploading content to a third-party service.
